question: Who acts as the real executive head in a state?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Chief Minister**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Chief Minister** is the **real executive head** of a state in India.
 
• As per the **Constitution of India**, the Chief Minister is the **leader of the ruling party** in the state legislature.
 
• The Chief Minister exercises all executive powers on behalf of the **Governor** who is the nominal head.
